source_scope_notes.pick_lines: Instructions, unique bin locations, executed visits, physical grabs and area-normalized density are different quantities. The source gives travel tendencies, not an exact route length. Two completeness/location premises were clarified.
source_scope_notes.batch_tradeoff: Compare avoided walking with every added cost, enforce space constraints, use a strict inequality for savings, and distinguish action fees from resulting total cost. Shared setup is charged once.
source_scope_notes.serial_parallel: Respect release times, dependencies and worker unavailability. Completion follows the critical path; active labor sums work durations. A proposal is not assumed to satisfy the deadline and labor budget.
source_scope_notes.transport_capacity: Apply capacity and request eligibility within each departure, distinguish cancelled requests, enforce connection times, and use the explicit work-conserving premise in inverse inference.
source_scope_notes.pest: Use external political/economic/social/technological scope; internal staffing is not itself a macro-environment factor.
source_scope_notes.abc: Apply the supplied source control-intensity definitions to already assigned classes; no unsupported numerical classification thresholds.
source_scope_notes.reorder: Retain the named MITx forecast-error RMSE and strictly-below inventory-position trigger; do not substitute a universal standard-deviation or equality-trigger rule.
source_scope_notes.rail_transfer: Retain the 2019 railway statistical scope: direct rail transfers and locomotive changes are excluded; an intervening road stage creates rail unloading/loading.
source_scope_notes.postponement: Keep product differentiation separate from shipment consolidation. Allocation flexibility does not erase sequential customization and delivery time.
source_scope_notes.contracts: Use the explicitly named Rodrigue/Slack vocabulary. Contracts, physical load-unit handling, carrier identity and transport mode are separate dimensions.
source_scope_notes.warehouse_roles: Classify demonstrated functions; a facility may have more than one function. Do not infer cross-docking from customer proximity.
source_scope_notes.shipping_controls: Map labels/weight/cube to Checking, protection/unitizing to Packing, and docks/loading optimization to Shipping. Repair only demonstrated defects.
source_scope_notes.outsourcing: Retain health-commodity source scope and ongoing KPI/contract-management responsibilities; a low quote does not prove reliability.
source_scope_notes.holding_cost: Avoid duplicate expenses; distinguish specified incremental and full-allocation cost boundaries, without claiming a universal carrying rate.

wording_amendments.before: Every completed instruction produced at least one event, and no event belongs to two instructions.
wording_amendments.after: Every recorded event belongs to exactly one completed instruction; no events from unfinished instructions are included. Every completed instruction produced at least one recorded event.
wording_amendments.reason: Completeness in the forward direction alone does not exclude events from unfinished instructions; distinct IDs must correspond exactly to completed instructions.
wording_amendments.trigger: Operator premise audit and substantive reviewer objections, not closed-book score selection

wording_amendments.before: J is the cheaper of the two allowed interventions.
wording_amendments.after: Choosing J yields a lower total batching cost, including its fee, than choosing I.
wording_amendments.reason: Cheaper intervention could mean its fee alone; the intended comparison is the complete resulting batching cost.
wording_amendments.trigger: Operator premise audit and substantive reviewer objections, not closed-book score selection

wording_amendments.before: Three feasible process designs start at 0.
wording_amendments.after: Three proposed process designs start at 0; their compliance with the deadline and labor budget must be checked.
wording_amendments.reason: Calling all designs feasible before checking the two constraints conflicts with the intended distinction between S, P and R.

model_review_failures.operator_reason: Separate orders contain A,B,C and B,C,D: quantities are 1,2,2,1, totaling six grabs and four merged bin instructions. The reduction is two visits. Reviewer text corrects its initial count but leaves stale truth booleans.

40-25-15=0, so break-even is true and strictly cheaper is false; +1 space gives one extra cost and -1 separation gives one saving. The reviewer final indices agree but the break-even boolean remains false.

Net costs relative to separate picking are +5, -1 and -2 for none, I and J. The revised fourth option explicitly compares total cost. Reviewer rationale and final indices accept all four, but the J-saving boolean remains false.
One wave saves 25-12-22=-9, not +13. Two waves save 50-24-22=4. Exhaustive enumeration gives 0,-9,-9,4. Reviewer option 0 omits setup and contradicts its own option 3 explanation.
Completion is max(11,7)+4=15; X leaves max(11,3)+4=15 and Y gives max(8,7)+4=12. Reviewer reasoning and final indices correct the reduction to three but keep a false boolean on that true statement.
Time-step reference gives pause/resume completion 19 and uninterrupted completion 20. Active work is 6+10+4+2=22 for both. Reviewer reasoning and final indices accept 22 but leave its boolean false.

Each departure carries eight under carry-every-eligible-request-up-to-ten with no other restrictions. min(d,10)=8<10 implies d=8, hence no capacity rejection. Reviewer denies this implication while correctly using it to reject demand twelve.

After shifting two, A needs seven and B needs five. A capacities 4,5,6,7 yield totals 9,10,11,12; B always leaves three places. All four claims hold. Reviewer final indices agree but the at-least-nine boolean remains false.
